title: Fix stale orphaned progress state
summary: Classify stale orphaned pipeline progress as a review state instead of active work when no live work is present.
reason: A closed/orphaned encode left pipeline_progress.json reporting Processing/encode, so the WebView topbar and close readiness continued to present a dead NVENC encode as active work.
behavior_before: A stale progress file with Status=Processing and CurrentStage=encode could drive pipeline_state=processing, current-work movie labels, and close warnings after the child process was already gone.
behavior_after: Snapshots whose activity is stale progress now report pipeline_state=stale, keep raw progress evidence for review, show stale current-work labels, and allow close when no live process/job/audit blocks it.
